description: Public-key encodings at the protocol boundary. Standards-native encodings are used; SComm does not invent representations.

msk.fingerprint: sha256 of the 32-byte public key, hex lowercase

pgp.wire: base64url of binary packets (not ASCII armor on the wire)

smime.material: X.509 / CMS SubjectPublicKeyInfo or certificate (includes smime-mlkem-*)

vectors.note: Generated solely for conformance tests. Never use outside tests.
